szenen.vo: [intense] Two people. Same dream. Same year. Only one difference.
[intense] This guy says, I'll start on Monday. Every. Single. Monday.
[intense] This guy starts today. Small steps. Boring work. Every day.
[shouting] December thirty-first! One has a whole year of work. The other one has excuses!
[intense] And on January first, he says it again. This year. [shouting] Don't be him. Start today!
